notes:
Literally 'not ceasing' ({不|ふ} + {断|だん}). Used as a modifier (with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧) to describe something that continues without interruption. Almost always appears in the set phrase {不断|ふだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧ (constant effort). Carries a positive connotation of diligence and persistence.

NOTE ON HOMOPHONE:
Do not confuse with ⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧ (usually, normally), which is the everyday word for 'ordinary' or 'usual'. They are completely different words that happen to share the same reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不断|ふだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧: constant effort
- {不断|ふだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧: continuous improvement
- {不断|ふだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: constant vigilance
- {不断|ふだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研鑽|けんさん}→研鑽：15484_kensan⟧: continuous self-improvement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{絶|た}え{間|ま}ない→絶え間ない：14911_taemanai⟧: unceasing, incessant — emphasizes no breaks or gaps
- ⟦{継続的|けいぞくてき}→継続的：05845_keizokuteki⟧: continuous — neutral, technical term for ongoing processes
- {弛|たゆ}まない: untiring, unwavering — emphasizes not slackening in effort
